## dmetar

**Doing Meta-Analysis in R**

![](reference/figures/front.png)

  

The **dmetar** package serves as the companion R package for the guide
[**Doing Meta-Analysis in R**](https://doing-meta.guide/) by Mathias
Harrer, Pim Cuijpers, Toshi Furukawa and David Daniel Ebert. The package
contains utility functions to facilitate the conduction of meta-analyses
using the **meta**, **metafor**, **netmeta** and **gemtc** packages.

  

## Installation

The latest development version can be installed from **GitHub** using
[**remotes**](https://remotes.r-lib.org/).

``` r
if (!require("remotes")) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
remotes::install_github("MathiasHarrer/dmetar")
```

  

## Learning More

The **dmetar** package was developed for the online guide **Doing
Meta-Analysis in R** by Mathias Harrer, Pim Cuijpers, Toshi Furukawa and
David Daniel Ebert. This guide gives an introduction on how
meta-analyses can be conducted in R, with a focus on biomedical and
psychological research.

The guide was designed to serve as a low-threshold entry point for
researchers who want to learn about meta-analysis using R. **No prior
knowledge of R or RStudio is required**. The guide provides a more
detailed overview of **dmetar** functions and how they can be used in
combination with go-to meta-analysis packages such as **metafor** or
**meta**.

[**View the Guide**](https://doing-meta.guide/)

  

## Questions & Bugs

For questions concerning the **dmetar** package, or to report bugs,
please contact **Mathias** (<mathias.harrer@tum.de>).

# Package index

## Effect size calculation

- [`NNT()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/NNT.md) : Calculate
  the number needed to treat (NNT)
- [`se.from.p()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/se.from.p.md) :
  Calculate the standard error from the effect size and p-value
- [`pool.groups()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/pool.groups.md)
  : Pool the results of two treatment arms

## Small-study effects & Publication bias

- [`eggers.test()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/eggers.test.md)
  : Perform Egger's test of the intercept

- [`find.outliers()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/find.outliers.md)
  : Find Statistical Outliers in a Meta-Analysis

- [`InfluenceAnalysis()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/InfluenceAnalysis.md)
  : Influence Diagnostics

- [`gosh.diagnostics()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/gosh.diagnostics.md)
  : Identify studies contributing to heterogeneity patterns found in
  GOSH plots

- [`pcurve()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/pcurve.md) :

  Perform a *p*-curve analysis

## Power analysis

- [`power.analysis()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/power.analysis.md)
  : A priori power calculator
- [`power.analysis.subgroup()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/power.analysis.subgroup.md)
  : A priori power calculator for subgroup contrasts

## Meta-regression & Subgroups

- [`multimodel.inference()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/multimodel.inference.md)
  : Perform multimodel inference with a meta-regression model
- [`subgroup.analysis.mixed.effects()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/subgroup.analysis.mixed.effects.md)
  : Subgroup analysis using a mixed-effects model

## Multilevel Meta-Analysis

- [`mlm.variance.distribution()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/mlm.variance.distribution.md)
  : Calculate I-squared values and variance distribution for multilevel
  meta-analysis models

## Network Meta-Analysis

- [`direct.evidence.plot()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/direct.evidence.plot.md)
  :

  Plot for direct evidence proportions in a network meta-analysis using
  `netmeta`

- [`sucra()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/sucra.md) :
  Calculate the Surface Under the Cumulative Ranking score of from a
  network meta-analysis

## Risk of bias

- [`rob.summary()`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/rob.summary.md)
  : Create a RevMan-style risk of bias summary chart

## Data sets

- [`BdiScores`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/BdiScores.md) :
  BDI-II and HAM-D Scores in Clinical Depression Trials
- [`Chernobyl`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/Chernobyl.md) :
  Ionizing Radiation from Chernobyl and Mutation Rates in Humans dataset
- [`DepressionMortality`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/DepressionMortality.md)
  : Effect of Depression on All-Cause Mortality
- [`EatingDisorderPrevention`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/EatingDisorderPrevention.md)
  : Prevention of Eating Disorders at Universities dataset
- [`HealthWellbeing`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/HealthWellbeing.md)
  : Association of Health and Well-being dataset
- [`m.gosh`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/m.gosh.md) : GOSH
  plot dataset
- [`MVRegressionData`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/MVRegressionData.md)
  : Toy Dataset for Multivariate Meta-Regression
- [`NetDataGemtc`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/NetDataGemtc.md)
  : Toy Dataset for Network Meta-Analyses using the gemtc package
- [`NetDataNetmeta`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/NetDataNetmeta.md)
  : Toy Dataset for Network Meta-Analysis using the netmeta package
- [`OpioidMisuse`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/OpioidMisuse.md)
  : Prevalence of Prescription Opioid Misuse in US Adolescents and Young
  Adults dataset
- [`SleepProblems`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/SleepProblems.md)
  : Factor Structure of Sleep Complaints data set
- [`SuicidePrevention`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/SuicidePrevention.md)
  : Effects of Suicide Prevention on Suicidal Ideation (toy dataset)
- [`TherapyFormats`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/TherapyFormats.md)
  : Differential Effects of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Delivery
  Formats in Depressive Patients dataset
- [`TherapyFormatsGeMTC`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/TherapyFormatsGeMTC.md)
  : Differential Effects of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Delivery
  Formats in Depressive Patients dataset
- [`ThirdWave`](http://dmetar.protectlab.org/reference/ThirdWave.md) :
  'Third-Wave' cognitive behavioral interventions for perceived stress
  in college students dataset
